@deskInvIssuerFormTitle.description: Title of the form that asks someone to pay you.

@deskInvIssuerFirstTitle.description: Panel title: the one-off steps the payer takes before they can be billed.

@deskInvIssuerYourAddress.description: Label: this wallet's normal Epicbox address, which the payer must trust.

@deskInvIssuerMethod.description: Label of the choice how the request travels: Epicbox, File, Link.

@deskInvIssuerEpicbox.description: Method: the request goes over the Epicbox relay. Product name, usually not translated.

@deskInvIssuerFile.description: Method: the request is saved as a file to hand over.

@deskInvIssuerDirect.description: Method: the payment comes straight to this wallet over HTTP or Tor.

@deskInvIssuerSoon.description: Why a method or button is disabled: not built yet.

@deskInvIssuerPayer.description: Field label: the payer's invoice address, where the request goes.

deskInvIssuerPayerHelp: Their wallet shows it under Settings › Invoices.

@deskInvIssuerPayerHelp.description: Help under the payer field: where the payer finds their invoice address.

@deskInvIssuerPayerMissing.description: Error: the payer field is empty.

deskInvIssuerPayerInvalid: This is not a valid Epicbox address.

@deskInvIssuerPayerInvalid.description: Error: the payer field holds something that is not an Epicbox address.

deskInvIssuerPayerOwn: This is one of your own addresses. Use the invoice address the payer gives you.

@deskInvIssuerPayerOwn.description: Error: the payer field holds this wallet's payments or invoice address.

deskInvIssuerPayerHttp: Invoices over Epicbox need an Epicbox address, not an HTTP or Tor one.

@deskInvIssuerPayerHttp.description: Error: an http(s) or onion address was given while the method is Epicbox.

@deskInvIssuerContacts.description: Button: pick the payer from contacts that have an invoice address.

deskInvIssuerNoContacts: No contact has an invoice address yet. Add it under Contacts.

@deskInvIssuerNoContacts.description: Shown in the contact picker when no contact has an invoice address.

deskInvIssuerNoInvoices: This wallet sent an invoice back before: it cannot pay invoices over Epicbox. Send them an invoice file instead, or ask them to send you the payment.

@deskInvIssuerNoInvoices.description: Warning on the request form: the payer's wallet is known not to pay requests.

@deskInvIssuerUseFile.description: Button: switch the request to the File method.

deskInvIssuerUnknown: Only wallet-for-epic and other LEPIC wallets can pay an invoice over Epicbox. The Epic GUI wallet and Stack Wallet cannot pay invoices at all; the epic-wallet command line can pay an invoice file.

@deskInvIssuerUnknown.description: Quiet line on the request form when nothing is known about the payer's wallet. Product names stay as they are.

@deskInvIssuerAmount.description: Field label: how much the payer is asked to pay, in EPIC.

@deskInvIssuerAmountMissing.description: Error: the amount field is empty or not a number.

deskInvIssuerAmountZero: The amount must be more than 0.

@deskInvIssuerAmountZero.description: Error: the amount is zero or negative.

@deskInvIssuerAmountDecimals.description: Error: the amount has more than 8 decimal places.

deskInvIssuerAmountCap: More than all the EPIC there will ever be.

@deskInvIssuerAmountCap.description: Error: the amount is above the coin's supply cap.

deskInvIssuerAmountHelp: Nothing leaves your wallet: the payer pays this amount plus their own fee.

@deskInvIssuerAmountHelp.description: Help under the amount: a request spends nothing from this wallet.

@deskInvIssuerMessage.description: Field label: optional text the payer sees with the request.

@deskInvIssuerMessageLong.description: Error: the message is over 256 bytes.

deskInvIssuerExpiry: The payer has {hours} hours to pay.

@deskInvIssuerExpiry.description: Line on the request form: how long the request stays payable (from Settings).

@deskInvIssuerIssue.description: Main button: send the payment request. No password is needed.

deskInvIssuerRelayDown: The Epicbox server is not answering, so an invoice cannot go out now.

@deskInvIssuerRelayDown.description: Why Request is disabled: the relay is down.

deskInvIssuerFixFields: Fix the fields marked in red.

@deskInvIssuerFixFields.description: Why Request did nothing: some fields have errors.

deskInvIssuerNotDelivered: The invoice did not reach the Epicbox server. Nothing was sent. Try again.

@deskInvIssuerNotDelivered.description: Error after Request: the relay did not take it; it was cancelled at once.

@deskInvIssuerSent.description: Notice after Request: delivered to the payer's invoice address.

deskInvIssuerEmpty: No invoices issued yet. An invoice asks a contact or a service to pay you; it spends nothing.

@deskInvIssuerTo.description: Row title of a request you sent.

@deskInvIssuerIssued.description: When the request was sent, e.g. 'Sent 21 Oct, 12:40'.

@deskInvIssuerPayerFact.description: Detail label: who was asked to pay.

@deskInvIssuerAmountFact.description: Detail label: the amount asked for.

@deskInvIssuerMessageFact.description: Detail label: the message sent with the request.

@deskInvIssuerSentFact.description: Detail label: when the request was sent.

@deskInvIssuerExpiresFact.description: Detail label: when the request stops being payable.

@deskInvIssuerAnsweredFact.description: Detail label: when the request left waiting (paid, declined, expired, withdrawn).

@deskInvIssuerStepConfirming.description: Progress step: the payment is in blocks.

deskInvIssuerEnded: This invoice ended unpaid. Nothing arrived.

@deskInvIssuerEnded.description: Detail text of a request that was declined, expired, withdrawn or sent back.

@deskInvIssuerWithdraw.description: Button: take back a waiting request.

@deskInvIssuerKeep.description: Dialog button: do not withdraw or cancel.

@deskInvIssuerRepost.description: Button: send the finished payment to the node again.

deskInvIssuerNodeDown: The node is not answering. Try again when it is reachable.

@deskInvIssuerNodeDown.description: Error: Repost or Cancel needs the node.

deskInvIssuerNotPostedText: The payment is finished but not on the network: the node refused it or could not be reached.

@deskInvIssuerNotPostedText.description: Detail text of a request in Not posted.

@deskInvIssuerCancel.description: Button (Advanced): cancel a paid request that was never posted.

deskInvIssuerCancelBody: It will not arrive. {payer}'s funds stay locked in their wallet until they cancel on their side.

@deskInvIssuerCancelBody.description: Confirm dialog text for cancelling a paid request on the receiving side.

deskInvIssuerBounced: {payer}'s wallet sent the invoice back: it cannot pay invoices. Ask them to send you a payment instead.

@deskInvIssuerBounced.description: Detail text and warning notice of a request the payer's wallet returned.

@deskInvIssuerSendFile.description: Button: make a request file for a payer whose wallet cannot pay over Epicbox.

deskInvIssuerLate: A payment arrived after this invoice ended. It was refused; nothing changed.

@deskInvIssuerLate.description: Quiet note on an ended request that got a late payment.

deskInvIssuerPaidText: {payer} paid. Your wallet finished the payment and posted it.

@deskInvIssuerPaidText.description: Detail text of a paid request.

deskInvIssuerWaitingText: Delivered to {payer}'s invoice address. Nothing is paid until they approve it.

@deskInvIssuerWaitingText.description: Detail text of a waiting request.

@deskInvIssuerCopySlate.description: Button tooltip: copy the request's technical identifier.

deskInvIssuerStepsIntro: Their wallet must take invoices. Before the first invoice:

@deskInvIssuerStepsIntro.description: Before the steps on the issue form: the payer must have done these once.

deskInvIssuerStepTrust: 1. They add your payments address below to their trusted senders.
deskInvIssuerStepAddress: 2. They give you their invoice address.

@deskInvIssuerStepIssued.description: Progress step: the invoice was issued and delivered.
